Welcome to Weft

Your vault is a folder of .html files. This is one of them.

Notes are plain .html on disk — portable, future-proof, and already web pages. Open any note in a browser tab and it just works.

Link between notes with standard anchors: ← this note. Weft parses <a href> tags on save to build backlinks automatically.

Getting started

  1. Add .html files to your vault folder — they appear in the browser instantly.
  2. Create a daily note at daily/YYYY-MM-DD.html for quick capture.
  3. Link freely. The brain panel (v0.2) will surface related notes automatically.
